name: com.subscriptionflow/mcp
title: SubscriptionFlow
description: Read and update SubscriptionFlow billing data: customers, invoices, subscriptions and reports.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the published SubscriptionFlow knowledge base by free-text query. Returns matching articles with ids you can pass to `fetch`. Only published content is searchable. Public, read-only.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one published SubscriptionFlow knowledge article by id (an id returned by `search`). Draft or unknown ids are not found. Public, read-only.

tools.name: sf_find_instance
tools.description: Given a work email, start the enumeration- and timing-safe instance lookup. For privacy the response is deliberately generic and constant — it never confirms or denies whether an account exists; if a match is found, instructions are sent to that email. Public, read-only.

tools.name: sf_request_demo
tools.description: Submit a request for a SubscriptionFlow demo. Validates and stores/forwards the request and returns a generic acknowledgement. Public, read-only.

message.description: Anything you want the team to know. Optional.

tools.name: sf_contact
tools.description: Send a message to the SubscriptionFlow team. Requires a name, work email, company and message; a phone number is optional. Returns a reference id the sender can quote. Nothing submitted is echoed back. Public, read-only.

name.description: Full name of the person getting in touch.

tools.name: sf_product_info
tools.description: Show what SubscriptionFlow does — features, the industries it serves, integrations, benefits or how pricing works. Use topic "all" to show everything at once. Public, read-only.

topic.description: Which area to show. Defaults to all.

tools.name: sf_demo_booking
tools.description: Show a form to book a product demo. Collects name, email and company, then opens the scheduling page with those details pre-filled. The lead itself is captured by `sf_request_demo`. Public, read-only.

tools.name: sf_contact_form
tools.description: Display an interactive form for getting in touch with the SubscriptionFlow team. The form collects a name, work email, company, optional phone number and a message, and submits them through `sf_contact`.

tools.name: sf_connection_status
tools.description: Check whether this connection is signed in to a SubscriptionFlow account. Call it when the user asks for their own SubscriptionFlow data (customers, subscriptions, invoices, payments, billing, reports) or for a change, and no account tools are listed. Right now the connection is not signed in; the result says how to reconnect. Read-only.
